deskripsi: Regener8 Healthcare is the creation of Geri Savova, an anaesthesia specialist, and Milan Mazic, an experienced businessman whose sports injury led to the birth of our clinic. It all started when their founder, Milan, an over-50s England walking football player, began having difficulties with his knee. After multiple operations, he was given the heart-wrenching news that he may never play football again. After exhausting every traditional path to rehabilitation, Milan met with Neil, who has over 20 years of physiotherapy experience working in professional football and Premiership rugby. He introduced Milan to an innovative new treatment known as MBST (Molecular Biophysical Stimulation Therapy). After a course of treatment on the MBST machine, Milan was astonished to find a significant reduction in his pain, and it wasn’t long before he was back on the pitch playing for his country. Following on from this victory, Milan, Geri, and Neil came together to create a specialised health and wellness clinic to help others in situations where traditional healthcare falls short. The trio found a home in the heart of Barnt Green for their clinic and thoroughly revitalised the space to create a calm and welcoming oasis for their new clients. Regener8 Healthcare is proud to offer an outstanding range of aesthetic and wellness treatments, backed by qualified care and diagnostics, state-of-the-art equipment, and a comprehensive suite of holistic health treatments to tackle issues from the inside out.
